auditScope: Status of the v1.4.0 source against each bounty requirement, with the evidence for it. pass: met and evidenced; partial: met in part, or not yet shown on the hardware or channel the requirement names; fail: not met. release-audit.md has the detail.

requirements.obligation: Run on compatible Android or GrapheneOS hardware
requirements.note: Runs on a Redmi 13C (Android 13) and an Infinix X6840 (Android 16); not yet run on a Pixel or GrapheneOS.

requirements.obligation: Stay within a maximum 12 GB RAM environment
requirements.note: The 2B needs about 2 GB; the optional 4B is offered only on phones reporting 7e9 bytes or more.

requirements.obligation: Use at most 50 GB total installed storage
requirements.note: Every offered collection and both models together take about 32 GB installed (the Encyclopedia alone 24.35 GB); installing the Encyclopedia needs about 43 GB at its peak, under the 50 GB limit.

requirements.obligation: Work completely offline after installation and asset provisioning
requirements.note: Research runs with airplane mode on and Wi-Fi off once a model and collections are installed.

requirements.obligation: Make no API, remote inference, web search, or network requests during use
requirements.note: Network use is limited by code to user-started downloads and catalog refresh; no traffic capture during research has been made.

requirements.obligation: Require no Google Play Services for core offline behavior
requirements.note: No Play Services dependency in the code or the APK; not yet run on a phone without them.

requirements.obligation: Handle explanation, comparison, synthesis, and reasoning beyond recall
requirements.note: Handled, but the 2B's own explanations score well below the reference on new questions.

requirements.obligation: Respond at speeds usable for real phone lookups
requirements.note: Measured on a Redmi 13C; no timings on a typical or flagship phone.

requirements.obligation: Publish the submission in a public GitHub repository
requirements.note: Public repository.

requirements.obligation: Include all code, assets, dependencies, and reproduction instructions
requirements.note: Code, patches, pack tools and their pinned inputs.

requirements.obligation: Document models, datasets, indexes, and other resources
requirements.note: Models and every offered collection with size, checksum, source and licence.

requirements.obligation: Work on real Android hardware at submission time
requirements.note: The 1.4.0 release source was installed and checked on a Redmi 13C with the local test key; the public-key APK cannot update that installation without uninstalling, so it was not installed there.

requirements.obligation: Install and run within minutes without substantial debugging
requirements.note: On a Redmi 13C, setup downloaded and installed the model and six collections through the app (4.1 GB in about 35 minutes) and answered offline; not yet run from the public APK on a clean phone, and the Encyclopedia was imported rather than downloaded.

requirements.obligation: Include assets or provide clear download and installation instructions
requirements.note: Models and collections download in the app from pinned Hugging Face revisions, each checked against its size and SHA-256; a .fapack can be imported instead.

requirements.obligation: Publish a public demo on X or Farcaster
requirements.note: Earlier demos show older builds; a 1.4.0 demo is still to be posted.

requirements.obligation: Demo offline use, hard queries, repository link, and approach
requirements.note: A 1.4.0 demo of offline use, hard questions and the vegan question is still to be recorded.

requirements.obligation: Submit a relevant POIDH screenshot with demo and repository links
requirements.note: The existing claim describes an older build.

requirements.obligation: Keep the functional reviewed version in GitHub at claim time
requirements.note: v1.4.0 is tagged and released at the reviewed source; the claim is still to be updated.

requirements.obligation: Avoid fraud, malware, plagiarism, material changes, and violations
requirements.note: Fork credited; the opening-hours reader and test texts that followed another submission were replaced; licences shipped in the app.

requirements.obligation: Measure against the greater-than-50-percent quality bar transparently
requirements.note: On 60 fresh questions written after the release build was frozen, graded blind twice against a frontier model's web-researched answers, the default Qwen3.5 2B reaches 34% of the reference (1.02 factual errors per answer) and the optional 4B 35% on the 55 without a phone position: the bar is not met. Method, limits and every graded answer are published.
